prompts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create the finished illustration asset for the "Proposed mechanism" section of a premium ear-stimulation product landing page. EDIT the provided user-selected stone sculpture reference. It is the exact appearance and composition reference, but REPLACE its existing short ear-to-temple coloured line with the fuller simplified biological network below.

PRESERVE THE SELECTED SCULPTURE: left-facing near-profile three-quarter view, complete head and short neck, matte chalk-white carved limestone/marble, fine mineral texture, blank sculpted eyes, no hair, no lifelike skin, elegant simplified features. Keep it recognisably carved stone with gently rounded contours; soften the sharp polygon planes without changing the overall face or pose. Premium broad soft studio lighting and restrained grey shadows. No earbuds, props, base, pedestal or additional objects.

TRANSPARENT REVEAL: A broad continuous transparent rear/side cranial shell extends from behind the brow/temple across the crown and back of head down to the upper neck. The opaque stone face and front of neck remain intact. The transparent curved shell defines the full head silhouette but its interior is EMPTY except for the coloured neural pathway. Clear, restrained transparency, no heavy frost. ABSOLUTELY NO white/grey brain, cortex folds, cerebral hemispheres, corpus callosum, cerebellum, complete brainstem silhouette, background organs or unrelated nerves. Do not use ghosted brain anatomy. The user explicitly wants ONLY the selected coloured network visible inside.

SHOW ONE REPRESENTATIVE PROPOSED PATHWAY WITH FOUR READABLE STAGES:
1. LOCAL EAR INPUT: A small delicate pink branching sensory fibre detail confined to the conchal bowl of the visible outer ear. Do not colour the whole ear. This is the intended peripheral input region.
2. INWARD SENSORY CONNECTION: One fine pink-to-purple path goes from that ear input INWARD/DEEP towards the LOWER CENTRAL BRAINSTEM region near the skull base. Replace and remove the original direct ear-to-temple route. The incoming path must not head straight upward into the cerebral cortex.
3. SMALL BRAINSTEM RELAYS: Two small, elongated violet relay forms, correctly arranged in relative anatomical order: NTS lower in the dorsal medulla near the skull base, LC above it in the dorsal pons. In this side projection the relay group is deep inside the head, behind the jaw and low in the skull, not at the temple or central upper head. Use delicate organic threadlike clusters rather than large circles, light bulbs, beads or glowing orbs. A thin connection indicates a simplified relay pathway; intervening circuitry is intentionally simplified.
4. REPRESENTATIVE WIDER CONNECTIONS: From the UPPER relay region, several extremely fine violet/lilac ascending fibres curve upward and fan gently into a sparse distributed network inside the upper head, representing wider attention and learning networks. Use three or four understated branching destinations as a grouped schematic network, not isolated glowing 'focus'/'memory' centres. No solid coloured cortical patches, no whole-brain activation. Give the upper head enough sparse branching detail that the wider network is apparent while remaining elegant and spacious.

COLOUR AND STYLE: Pink peripheral input; violet-purple downstream relays and connections, with gentle gradients between them. Only this neural network is coloured. Keep subtle illumination for legibility, very limited bloom and fine crisp fibres, no lightning, rainbow, gold or neon fog. Readable against a cool off-white webpage, including at 500px display size. The nerve forms should appear suspended within the transparent back of the stone sculpture with open negative space around them.

This is a schematic proposed signalling mechanism grounded in the relative arrangement of peripheral auricular sensory input, lower brainstem relays and wider ascending networks. It is NOT a measured brain-activation map or an exact tractography scan. Do not invent other organs or show electrical current flowing directly into cortex.

OUTPUT: One polished high-resolution square illustration with generous margins around the uncropped head and neck. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no floor, backdrop or environment. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, legend, watermark, logo, UI or border; annotations will be added separately in the webpage.

Make one targeted anatomical-layout correction to this illustration. Keep the stone sculpture, face, ear, texture, pose, pink-and-purple palette, sparse upper branching network and transparent background exactly as they are.

The TWO PURPLE RELAY BUNDLES are currently too high, at the temple. REMOVE them from those positions and MOVE BOTH DOWN to the lower deep brainstem region near the skull base. They must also become MUCH SMALLER, slim and elongated, about one third of their current bulk.

Use these clear visual placements in this image:
- LOWER relay (schematic NTS): deep inside the head at approximately the height of the BOTTOM of the visible earlobe, inward to the left of the ear. Approximately 62 percent across the canvas and 55 percent down.
- UPPER relay (schematic LC): just above the lower relay, approximately at the height of the visible EAR CANAL, inward/deep to the left of the ear. Approximately 61 percent across and 46 percent down.
These guide coordinates are NOT labels and must not appear in the image. The lower relay must be below the ear-canal level. The upper relay must not be near the forehead or temple.

REROUTE the fine pink input from the outer-ear concha inward and SLIGHTLY DOWN to the lower relay. Connect lower relay upward to upper relay with one slender violet connection. From the upper relay, a longer slender ascending purple stem rises into the existing sparse branching upper network. There must be NO leftover knot, glowing hub or bundle at either old high location. Branches can pass through the old region but without any relay node there.

Extend the transparent side/rear reveal slightly downward towards the upper neck, only as needed to make BOTH lowered relays fully visible through it. The rest of the sculpture remains smooth rounded opaque white stone. No white brain, no cortex, cerebellum or other internal anatomy. Only the coloured proposed pathway is visible within the clear empty shell. No text, numbers, coordinate marks, labels, arrows, backdrop or other additions. Preserve genuine alpha background.
